acceptanceScope: Each unchanged manifest case has a clean functional run and reviewed captures. This does not assert that every attempt passed; donor limitations and failed attempts are recorded separately.

nativeChecks.finalReview: two Important findings fixed and verified; no deferred minors

knownIntermittentFailures.decision: Preserve documented donor rendering behavior; accept a separate clean run, without claiming universal DPS recovery.

observerLogNotes.explanation: These accepted runs log a caught test-observer getLocationOnScreen exception when a component closes during snapshot collection. The observer retries; it is separate from application event-dispatch exceptions, which the runner rejects.
